## FIRST RULE

After your first successful edit_file or write_file, your very next action
is submit_patch. Then continue working and call submit_patch again after
every further change. submit_patch is free — it does not count against your
tool-call budget. If you time out, only your last submitted patch is scored.

## Scratch files

Write any reproduction or debugging script to /tmp, never inside /workspace.
Everything left in /workspace becomes part of your submitted patch.
Do not modify test files, conftest.py or pytest.ini — those changes are
stripped before grading, so editing them wastes tool calls.

## Scope

Most fixes in these repositories touch ONE file and change fewer than ten
lines. Modify existing code rather than adding new code. Do not refactor,
reformat, or make unrelated changes. If your patch is growing past a few
files, stop and reconsider the diagnosis.

Exception: if the issue asks for functionality that does not exist yet,
create the file or function it describes, and match any names, CLI flags
or interfaces the issue specifies exactly.

## Finding the code

Start with grep:
  run_command("grep -rn '<symbol>' --include='*.py' .")
Read files only after grep has narrowed the candidates. Keep read_file
ranges tight — each call returns at most 150 lines and consumes context
you will need later.

def get_redoc_html(
    *,
    openapi_url: Annotated[
        str,
        Doc(
            """
            The OpenAPI URL that ReDoc should load and use.

            This is normally done automatically by FastAPI using the default URL
            `/openapi.json`.

            Read more about it in the
            [FastAPI docs for Conditional OpenAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/how-to/conditional-openapi/#conditional-openapi-from-settings-and-env-vars)
            """
        ),
    ],
    title: Annotated[
        str,
        Doc(
            """
            The HTML `<title>` content, normally shown in the browser tab.

            Read more about it in the
            [FastAPI docs for Custom Docs UI Static Assets](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/how-to/custom-docs-ui-assets/)
            """
        ),
    ],
    redoc_js_url: Annotated[
        str,
        Doc(
            """
            The URL to use to load the ReDoc JavaScript.

            It is normally set to a CDN URL.

            Read more about it in the
            [FastAPI docs for Custom Docs UI Static Assets](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/how-to/custom-docs-ui-assets/)
            """
        ),
    ] = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/redoc@2/bundles/redoc.standalone.js",
    redoc_favicon_url: Annotated[
        str,
        Doc(
            """
            The URL of the favicon to use. It is normally shown in the browser tab.
            """
        ),
    ] = "https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/img/favicon.png",
    with_google_fonts: Annotated[
        bool,
        Doc(
            """
            Load and use Google Fonts.
            """
        ),
    ] = True,
) -> HTMLResponse:
    """
    Generate and return the HTML response that loads ReDoc for the alternative
    API docs (normally served at `/redoc`).

    You would only call this function yourself if you needed to override some parts,
    for example the URLs to use to load ReDoc's JavaScript and CSS.

    Read more about it in the
    [FastAPI docs for Custom Docs UI Static Assets (Self-Hosting)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/how-to/custom-docs-ui-assets/).
    """
    html = f"""
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html>
    <head>
    <title>{title}</title>
    <!-- needed for adaptive design -->
    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    """
    if with_google_fonts:
        html += """
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Montserrat:300,400,700|Roboto:300,400,700" rel="stylesheet">
    """
    html += f"""
    <link rel="shortcut icon" href="{redoc_favicon_url}">
    <!--
    ReDoc doesn't change outer page styles
    -->
    <style>
      body {{
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
      }}
    </style>
    </head>
    <body>
    <noscript>
        ReDoc requires Javascript to function. Please enable it to browse the documentation.
    </noscript>
    <redoc spec-url="{openapi_url}"></redoc>
    <script src="{redoc_js_url}"> </script>
    </body>
    </html>
    """
    return HTMLResponse(html)
